basic_details.job_title: JSSH Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 70 Senior Resident Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Resident (Anesthesia), Senior Resident (Biochemistry), Senior Resident (Cardiology) and 12 more
basic_details.short_information: Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital (An Autonomous Institute) (JSSH), New Delhi, Delhi, has invited applications for 70 posts in 15 roles under Advt No. F.1(1401)/JSSH/Estt./Regular SR/2026/2433. The posts include Senior Resident (Anesthesia), Senior Resident (Biochemistry), Senior Resident (Cardiology), Senior Resident (CTVS) and 11 more. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 8 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: POS machine (through Credit/Debit Card only) at Accounts Branch (Room No. 104).

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: Broad specialities: MBBS with PG Degree (MD/MS)/Diploma/DNB in the concerned speciality. Super specialities: PG Degree (MD/MS)/DNB in Medicine/Surgery with DM/MCh/DrNB/Fellowship in the concerned super speciality. Ad hoc alternatives with experience are allowed when qualified candidates are not available.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 plus admissible allowances per month)

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed Application Form for Senior Resident printed in the notice, with the Undertaking.
Write the name and discipline of the post on the envelope and on the first page of the application form.
Pay the fee through the POS machine (Credit/Debit Card only) at Accounts Branch, Room No. 104.
Enclose the fee transaction receipt and self-attested copies of certificates in the checklist order.
Send by Speed Post to The Director, Administrative Block, 1st Floor, JSSH, C-2B, Jankapuri, New Delhi – 110058.
Application must reach by 08.12.2026 till 04.00 P.M.; direct submission at JSSH is also mentioned with office timings.
important_instructions: No separate call letters will be issued for interviews No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview Bring all original documents, one attested photocopy of each certificate and one passport size photograph to the interview Hospital is not responsible for postal delay; late or incomplete applications will be rejected Any corrigendum will be published only on the websites of the hospital and Department of H&FW, GNCTD Queries may be sent to [email protected]

content_sections.text: Shortlisting on the basis of experience and qualifications in case of large number of applications Screening written test, if required Interview by a Board constituted by the Competent Authority Candidates may also be put through a screening written test, if required Shortlisted list displayed on www.jsshs.org under Career & Opportunities and Administrative block notice board before 22.12.2026 Interview on 22.12.2026 (Tuesday), 10.30 A.M. onwards, Board Room, MS Office, First Floor, JSSH; report one hour before Decision of the Chairman of the Selection board is final

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JSSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in JSSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 70 vacancies: 10 Senior Resident (Anesthesia), 2 Senior Resident (Biochemistry), 2 Senior Resident (Cardiology), 4 Senior Resident (CTVS), 8 Senior Resident (Gastroenterology), 4 Senior Resident (GI Surgery) and 9 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for JSSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application Form for Senior Resident and Undertaking printed in this notice (pages 6 to 10)) and send it to The Director, Administrative Block, 1st Floor, Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital, C-2B, Jankapuri, New Delhi – 110058, by speed post, to reach by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Unreserved: Rs. 1000. OBC/SC/ST/EWS: Rs. 500. Persons with Disabilities (PwD): Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Senior Resident (Anesthesia): 45 years for UR/EWS categories; Senior Resident (Biochemistry): maximum 50 years for all categories; Senior Resident (Cardiology): 45 years for UR/EWS categories; Senior Resident (CTVS): 45 years for UR/EWS categories; Senior Resident (Gastroenterology): 45 years for UR/EWS categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 plus admissible allowances per month) for Senior Resident (Anesthesia), Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 plus admissible allowances per month) for Senior Resident (Biochemistry), Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 plus admissible allowances per month) for Senior Resident (Cardiology), Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 plus admissible allowances per month) for Senior Resident (CTVS), Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 plus admissible allowances per month) for Senior Resident (Gastroenterology).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Broad specialities: MBBS with PG Degree (MD/MS)/Diploma/DNB in the concerned speciality. Super specialities: PG Degree (MD/MS)/DNB in Medicine/Surgery with DM/MCh/DrNB/Fellowship in the concerned super speciality. Ad hoc alternatives with experience are allowed when qualified candidates are not available. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must have a valid DMC registration certificate. Only OBC candidates of Delhi are eligible in the OBC category, with certificate from Govt. of NCT of Delhi. OBC non-creamy layer certificate must be issued within three months before the last date of application. Candidate should not have been convicted by any court of law.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants without the requisite qualifications up to the last date for submission of applications.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting on the basis of experience and qualifications in case of large number of applications. Screening written test, if required. Interview by a Board constituted by the Competent Authority. Candidates may also be put through a screening written test, if required.
